title: How to Get a PSA CENOMAR (Certificate of No Marriage)
description: Obtain proof of single status required for marriage licenses and visa applications.

requirements.title: Valid ID
requirements.description: A government-issued ID for identity verification.

requirements.title: Personal Details
requirements.description: Full name, birth date, place of birth, and parents' maiden names.

checklist.title: Prepare Details
checklist.description: Gather your valid ID and complete personal information needed for verification.

checklist.title: Choose Method
checklist.description: Select between online application for home delivery or walk-in processing at a PSA outlet.

checklist.title: Pay Fees
checklist.description: Settle the applicable fees using GCash, Maya, or other authorized payment channels.

checklist.description: Collect your certificate at the PSA outlet or wait for it to be delivered to your home.

blocks.content: A PSA CENOMAR (Certificate of No Marriage Record) is an official document issued by the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) certifying that a person has no registered marriage in the Philippine civil registry database.
It is commonly required when applying for a marriage license, visa, employment abroad, loans, or other legal transactions requiring proof of civil status.

The PSA CENOMAR is commonly used for:
* Marriage license applications
* Visa and immigration requirements
* Employment or overseas work applications

You may need a PSA CENOMAR if you are:
- Applying for a marriage license in the Philippines
- Processing visa or immigration documents
- Applying for certain government or private sector requirements

blocks.title: Proof of Civil Status
blocks.content: The document officially certifies that you have no registered marriage record under the PSA database.

blocks.title: Required for Marriage Applications
blocks.content: Most Local Civil Registry Offices require a CENOMAR before issuing a marriage license.

blocks.title: Accepted for Legal Transactions
blocks.content: Embassies, employers, banks, and government agencies commonly accept PSA-issued CENOMAR documents.
Applicants may request a PSA CENOMAR through online services or walk-in applications.

blocks.title: Online Application
blocks.content:
Applicants may request online through:
* PSAHelpline
* PSA Serbilis
* PSA e-Certificate services
Documents may be delivered to your home address or provided digitally (if available).

blocks.title: Walk-In Application
blocks.content: Applicants may process requests at PSA Civil Registry System (CRS) outlets and selected SM Business Centers.
Most PSA outlets require online appointment booking before visiting.
**Pro Tip:** Always double-check for 'Negative Results'. If your record is missing, you must process **Late Registration** at the LCR where the event occurred.

blocks.title: Prepare Requirements
blocks.content: Prepare your valid ID and complete personal information needed for verification.

blocks.title: Submit Your Application
blocks.content:
Choose either:
* Online application through PSA-authorized websites
* Walk-in processing at PSA CRS outlets
Fill out the application form carefully.

blocks.title: Pay the Fees
blocks.content:
Pay using available payment methods such as:
* GCash
* Maya
* Debit/Credit Card
* Over-the-counter payment centers

blocks.title: Claim or Receive the Document
blocks.content:
Depending on your application method:
* Walk-in requests may be released on the same day
* Online applications are delivered via courier or email (for e-certificates)

Applicants may process their PSA CENOMAR at:
- PSA Civil Registry System (CRS) Outlets
- Selected SM Business Centers
- PSAHelpline website
- PSA Serbilis website

Typical processing timelines include:
* PSA CRS Walk-In: Same day to 1 business day
* Online Delivery (Metro Manila): 2–5 business days
* Provincial Delivery: 3–8 business days
* SM Business Center Requests: 7–10 business days

Applicants may monitor their application through:
* PSAHelpline tracking system
* Courier tracking updates
* Email or SMS notifications

Applicants may experience:
- “No Record Found” results due to incorrect details
- Delayed courier delivery
- Name mismatches between IDs and PSA records
- Appointment slot availability issues

items: Entering incorrect birth details or parent names
Waiting until the last minute before deadlines

blocks.content: Always review your application before final submission.

items: Book appointments early in the morning
Use online applications if you cannot visit PSA offices
Bring extra photocopies of IDs and receipts
Save digital copies of payment confirmations

blocks.content:
To request your PSA CENOMAR online or book an appointment, visit:
- [PSAHelpline Official Portal](https://psahelpline.ph)
- [PSA Serbilis Official Portal](https://www.psaserbilis.com.ph)

blocks.title: Is a CENOMAR required for marriage in the Philippines?
blocks.content: Yes. Most Local Civil Registry Offices require a PSA CENOMAR before issuing a marriage license.

blocks.title: Can I request a CENOMAR for another person?
blocks.content: Yes, but additional requirements such as authorization letters and IDs may be required.

blocks.title: How long is a PSA CENOMAR valid?
blocks.content: Validity depends on the requesting institution. Many offices accept documents issued within the last 6 months.

blocks.title: Can I get a digital copy of my CENOMAR?
blocks.content: Yes. PSA now offers e-Certificate services for eligible applicants.

blocks.title: What happens if I previously had a marriage record?
blocks.content: Instead of a CENOMAR, PSA may issue an Advisory on Marriage.
